finding: New rainbow-split obstruction: start with n-1 Hamilton cycles decomposing K_n*, remove one edge from each, and make the removed edges one Hamilton path P. Any distance-2 pair of P cannot lose an old cyclic distance-2 occurrence: a removed edge on the old two-step occurrence would force two consecutive P edges to have the same source cycle. Therefore every distance-2 pair of P must be originally missing. In a multiplicatively developed F11 source with fixed 0, every pair to/from 0 already occurs once at cyclic distance 2; every 11-vertex P has a distance-2 pair incident to 0. Thus the entire one-rainbow-path insertion family is obstructed, not just the published Example 2 or its local trades.
